scripts.upload: gsutil -m rm -r gs://poc-nextjs/* && gsutil -m cp -r out/* gs://poc-nextjs
scripts.cache-html-header: gsutil setmeta -h 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=300' gs://poc-nextjs/**/*.html
scripts.cache-static-header: gsutil setmeta -h 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable' gs://poc-nextjs/**/*.{css,js}
scripts.cache-all-header: npm run cache-static-header & npm run cache-html-header
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run upload && npm run cache-all-header && npm run clear-cdn
